chapter: In The Mood, Rendezvous and Capitol
title: The 1964 Capitol Swanee River session
summary: Love reads the Billboard notice of the 1964 Capitol single; the session did nothing.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x:
Now I can show you the same thing
over here, this first session we did with Capi-
tol. I got to be then--I was a little fish in
a big pond, but when I was with Rendevous, I
was the biggest thing that Rendevous had, and
see, Rod hustled and put that over. Capitol
didn't pay a dime.

This is December 12,
1964, Ernie Fields, Capitol, 5326.

Ernie Fields who clicked some time
ago with his In The Mood revival, bows on Capi-
tol with his R & B Dixie reading of the Foster
classic Swanee River. Banjos, harmonicas, and
pulsating rhythm section in a wild sax flight
make for contemporary listening.
I remember hearing Swanee River but not on the jukeboxes.
